raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions holds 30 txn_ids with two versions (record_version 1 and 2), and silver_transactions keeps both rows, which causes the duplicate keys. The fix is to keep only the latest record_version per txn_id, deduplicating before the POSTED filter so a superseding REVERSED version is not overlooked. The gold tables are rebuilt from silver, so they are corrected by the same change.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) latest WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
